notes: Independent review: partition complete on both sides (27 source / 42 target, each ID once). ou me held as one noncompositional unit headed on ou/'no' per the REV.18.21 convention, with eti -> 'more' separate. Phrasal and periphrastic verbs head on the lexical verb (took, cast, cast down, found); blethesetai's discontinuous 'shall ... be cast down' correctly skips the intervening subject phrase without absorbing it. Noun phrases atomized per rules 13/26; determiners kept as helpers on their nouns. Medium-confidence calls on heis -> 'a' and hormemati -> 'with a mighty fall' are defensible with their notes. No changes.
